scope: Source mapping for the five distinct comparison-model implementations in starkzee.models; the public griem name is an alias of voigt.

stehle.classification: tabulated source plus StarkZee wrapper operations

primary_source.citation: C. Stehle and R. Hutcheon, Extensive tabulations of Stark broadened hydrogen line profiles, A&AS 140 (1999) 93-97

stehle.directly_sourced: The field-free profile arrays and their coordinate metadata come from the catalog-derived NetCDF recorded in starkzee/data/reference_tables.json.
stehle.starkzee_specific: Interpolation choices, finite-window normalization, Doppler convolution, isotope line-center/mass selection, and the separable normal-Zeeman triplet are wrapper operations, not additional fields contained in VI/98A.

rosato.classification: tabulated source plus corrected interpolation and wrapper operations

primary_source.citation: J. Rosato, Y. Marandet, and R. Stamm, A new table of Balmer line shapes for the diagnostic of magnetic fusion plasmas, JQSRT 187 (2017) 333-337

rosato.directly_sourced: The detuning and intensity arrays exactly match the pinned 3,000-file archive recorded in starkzee/data/reference_tables.json.
rosato.starkzee_specific: Four-corner logarithmic interpolation repairs the historical reader; Doppler convolution, output normalization, the H isotope approximation, and negative-value policies are wrapper behavior.

primary_source.citation: B. A. Lomanowski et al., Inferring divertor plasma properties from hydrogen Balmer and Paschen series spectroscopy in JET-ILW, Nuclear Fusion 55 (2015) 123028

stehle_param.directly_sourced: The transition coefficients, power-law FWHM, and absolute-detuning-to-the-5/2 modified Lorentzian are direct transcriptions of Eq. (1), Eq. (2), and Table 1.
stehle_param.starkzee_specific: Frequency-domain Doppler convolution, NIST-centered isotope handling, finite-grid normalization, and the separable normal-Zeeman triplet are implementation operations.

lomanowski.classification: StarkZee-specific sensitivity approximation using published widths

primary_source.citation: B. A. Lomanowski et al., Inferring divertor plasma properties from hydrogen Balmer and Paschen series spectroscopy in JET-ILW, Nuclear Fusion 55 (2015) 123028

lomanowski.directly_sourced: Only the transition coefficients and power-law Stark FWHM are transcribed from Eq. (1) and Table 1.
lomanowski.starkzee_specific: The common-width modified-Lorentzian/Gaussian pseudo-mixture is not the profile prescribed by the cited paper or by pystark; the historical provenance of its mixing polynomials is unknown. It must be treated as a sensitivity model.

primary_source.citation: H. R. Griem, Principles of Plasma Spectroscopy, Cambridge University Press (1997)

voigt.directly_sourced: The density-to-the-2/3 Stark-width scaling and alpha_12 coefficient convention are attributed to Griem.
voigt.starkzee_specific: The exact page/table provenance of every bundled alpha_12 number has not been recovered. StarkZee evaluates a Faddeeva Voigt, adds a separable normal-Zeeman triplet, and normalizes on the requested finite grid.
